verdict.rationale: docs.gusto.com serves a plain-text llms.txt index (HTTP 200) that lists every guide and API reference page as markdown links, and individual docs pages are served as .md files an agent can ingest directly. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the index, and confirmation the index covers more than the Embedded Payroll documentation set (it opens as "Embedded Payroll Documentation").

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
